reset.title: Danger zone
reset.description: These actions throw data away. Each one asks for confirmation first.
reset.clearHistoryDescription: Deletes every recorded call and its token and cost data from usage.db.
reset.clearHistoryConfirm: Every recorded call — with its tokens, timings, errors, and cost estimates — is deleted from usage.db. This cannot be undone. A running gateway keeps recording new calls afterwards.
reset.disconnectAllDescription: Runs owo disconnect for every connected app and restores their original settings.
reset.disconnectAllConfirm_one: This app stops sending requests through OwO AI Gateway. Its original settings are restored from the backup made when it was connected.
reset.disconnectAllConfirm_other: These {{count}} apps stop sending requests through OwO AI Gateway. Their original settings are restored from the backups made when they were connected.
reset.resetConfigDescription: Replaces config.toml with the starter config; a backup of the current file is kept.
reset.resetConfigConfirm: This is the most destructive action here. Before it runs, read what it does:
reset.resetConfigLoses: Every provider, model, and app setting in config.toml is lost; the starter config takes its place.
reset.resetConfigBackup: The current file is first copied to <path>{{path}}</path>.
reset.resetConfigKeyring: Keys in the OS keyring are not deleted; add the providers again to reuse them.
reset.resetConfigApps: Connected apps stay connected, but their requests fail until a provider is added.
reset.resetConfigRestart: The gateway must be restarted to pick up the new config.
reset.configReset: config.toml reset to the starter config

template.description: What this skill does and when to use it.

editor.hint: Every Markdown file is edited here; SKILL.md is the entry point (YAML frontmatter with name and description). Other files: open the folder. One Save writes everything and backs the folder up first. Ctrl+S saves.
editor.name: Name
editor.badName: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 64
editor.descriptionLong: description is {{count}} characters; the limit is {{max}}
editor.bodyEmpty: The body below the frontmatter is empty
editor.entryLong: SKILL.md has {{count}} lines; keep it under {{max}} and move details into other files
editor.notEditable: This folder is a link; edit it at its target
editor.detachDescription: It stops updating from its source. The current files are backed up first.
editor.fileHint: Relative path ending in .md, e.g. references/api.md
editor.badPath: Not a valid path inside the skill
editor.deleteFolder: {{files}} files and {{folders}} folders inside go too, when you save. The skill folder is backed up first.
editor.discardDescription: Edits and new or deleted files that are not saved are lost.

skills.turnOnForHint: Skills live in ~/.agents/skills. Claude Code gets a link; apps that read the folder are switched through their own settings. MiniMax Code and Claude Desktop are not supported.
